description: Lists of objects with different attributes and a set of maps unify keeping attribute values
notes: The spec unifies the objects to object({a = string, b = string, c = string}), filling missing attributes with null, so p's b stays "x". hashicorp/hcl picks the set of maps of strings instead (it can't convert an object to one with an attribute it lacks), which gives "x" too. go-cty doesn't rank objects with different attributes against each other (compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go); if it ranked them by their common attribute, the three lists would rank in a circle and sortTypes in cty/convert/sort_types.go would never reach the set.
